written_by: paper evaluator (overseer session), from the accepted population surface and the thirty frozen questions only, before phase two
surface: 31 record types: ENTITY 25, EVENT 2, RELATION 4; subject-bearing Claim, Observation, CountObservation, GeochemicalObservation, GeophysicalObservation, ElementRatio; subtypes on the surface: the three observation kinds of Observation, ElementRatio of Ratio, RockSampleSet of Sample, ReferencedWork of Source, ResearchCruise of Campaign, SeismicEvent of Event, ContributionRelation of ResearchRelation
method: one set per question id; a set lists the types the question is about and every surface subtype of each listed type (type_set_closure); under v4.13 a listed subject-bearing type reaches its subject-carrying records whatever their subjects' types (SUBJECT_ANY), so subject types are listed for what the question is about, not for reach; the carrying types E-0342 found omitted are listed where the question asks for them (Instrument on the recording-duration question, the dataset as ReferencedWork and the counts on the catalogue question, the observation types on the crustal-thickness question); Ratio, Sample, Source and Campaign are never listed as such, their concrete subtypes are, except Campaign and Observation whose subtypes are all listed beside them; ReferencedWork (the 79-entry reference list) only where a study, repository, dataset or publication record is asked; SeismicEvent listed where the question is about earthquakes as occurrences, because on this surface SeismicEvent wears Quantified; Evidence where an evidence relation is asked; NumericalModel on the solubility-model question; FundingAward and ResearchAgent with the research relations on the grant question
